prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose a pet companion that fits your daily routine and workflow style.", "Select Companion"]
1: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Preparing 3D desktop model", "Visit Nursery Preview"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and preserve your pet progress.", "Using your main login ensures custom pet files link to your saved profile."]
3: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Desktop!", "Look at the bottom corner of your screen to see your pet active and walking.", "Say Hello!"]
4: ["Generating high-resolution desktop animations. This usually takes 2-3 minutes.", "Estimated finish time", "Did you know? Your pet stays active while you work in other apps."]
5: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick an instant companion template or craft a unique custom pet from your photos.", "You can always adopt additional pets of any type later."]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Best results: Well-lit front face photos with visible ears.", "Front view photo, Good lighting, Neutral background"]
7: ["Welcome Home! Here is Your Starter Gift", "Your pet brought 50 starter treats to help you get acquainted.", "+50 Starter Treats Unlocked"]
8: ["We are Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a notification when your pet is ready."]
9: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Sign in with your previous login method to automatically restore your adopted pets.", "Already adopted a pet before? Use your original account to restore it."]
